_comment: The one table of git remote forms, read by both parsers: backend GitRemoteParserTest and
frontend gitRemote.spec.ts. Two implementations of one rule drift the moment they are tested
separately, and a UI that previews a different key from the one the API derives is worse than no
preview at all - so the table lives in one file and neither side owns it.
See docs/ONTOLOGY.md for why a Repository is keyed on its remote.
